current_suggestion.pitch: William Green interviews elite investors (Mohnish Pabrai, Guy Spier, Bill Miller) but consistently steers toward the philosophy of living well under uncertainty — Stoicism, mental models, and what a good life looks like — which your current channels (Ben Felix, Peter Attia) touch only incidentally. Where Farnam Street gives you frameworks abstractly, Green draws them out through deeply personal long-form conversations with people who've tested ideas against real stakes. Solo essays and interviews, typically 60–90 minutes, with a literary and philosophical depth that sits between Lex Fridman and EconTalk.
